description: Source code for protobuf naming utilities within Kubernetes code generator, including classes and functions for managing type names, packages, and conversions between Go and protobuf types.

classes.name: localNamer
classes.description: Handles naming of local types, including map types and package-relative names.

classes.name: protobufNamer
classes.description: Manages protobuf package references, type naming, and conversion between Go and protobuf types.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Generates a name for a type, handling maps and package-relative names.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a protobuf package to the namer’s tracking.

methods.name: GoNameToProtoName
methods.description: Converts a Go type name to a protobuf type name.

methods.name: AssignTypesToPackages
methods.description: Assigns Go types to protobuf packages based on the current context.
